integrity: An independently written exact-rational permutation-level checker verifies the witness and all five partitions; universal two-player lower bound is analytic. No independent external audit or publication-priority certification.
limitations: The example is an unrestricted, nonmonotone TU characteristic function; existence under monotone/superadditive/convex classes is not decided. The original conditional invariance result with an added independent monotonicity premise is not contradicted.
title: Three-player nonexistence of Shapley-fair merge-stable partitions
